reviews.title: WORST APP I HAVE EVER HAD THE MISFORTUNE OF USING!!
reviews.text:
THIS APP IS A SCAM!!!!!!
I have never written a bad review for an app before, but I’ve made an exception for My Drama. The way they operate is absolutely appalling! You pay for a subscription, which only gets you a few episodes, and then they want you to pay more money?
Their response to every review saying that they were charged without knowing is “Please know that we never charge without user authorization.” The “ authorization” is what using their app? I’m sure if I get a response it will say the exact same thing. 
It is such a hassle to cancel your subscription and clearly they make it like that so that people won’t cancel. Which that within itself is predatory. if anyone asks what I think about My Drama, I will tell them to not walk but run away.

I wish I read the reviews before using this app because there are so many that talk about the same thing that I’m talking about and some date back months and nothing has changed. If you could rate an app negative stars that’s what I would be doing.

reviews.title: Take your money and won’t cancel service! Warning!
reviews.text: I messaged them on May 11 asking them to cancel my service and they asked me to do it through the website. I couldn’t get it to work. But since I had asked them, I had hoped that they would do it for me since I had it in writing that I told them I don’t have the funds or income any longer to continue the subscription. Then eleven days later they charged me a new subscription fee!  They told me since I hadn’t provided them screenshots that they wouldn’t cancel the subscription!  I hadn’t seen any demands for screenshots and if they asked for them, why are they needed to cancel the subscription fee?  Don’t get this service. They will play stupid to get out of canceling it when you want to stop the service. After some complaints they canceled it right away so they can indeed cancel it easily from their end if they so choose to. Now I’m out of money I really don’t have because of their greed.

reviews.title: Disappointed and disgusted
reviews.text: These people offered me a one week trial for £5.99 they then took the £5.99 that I agreed to and then they took to immediate payment payments of £10 and £11 without my authorisation don’t answer their messages or resolve anything and I’ve had to contact the fraudulent team of my bank Bank to assist me absolutely disgusting. Do not use these people.

reviews.title: This is a scam
reviews.text:
I was charged twice. The company is refusing a refund because I had access to VIP for two hours before I noticed. And because by selecting continue purchase when a pop up came up that was me agreeing to an additional charge apparently. Personally I think that’s unclear and given I contacted the company quickly a full refund of the pop up charge for VIP should be issued. There’s a phone number attached to the emails from the company they go unanswered. I understood the quality of the movies was poor, poor acting, even poor English, I did not expect customer service to be so abhorrent.

I did reach out to you, your team was smug and unhelpful. Repeating themselves similar to how you have done here. “Each purchase requires user confirmation” but it doesn’t. I’m not new to in app purchases or buying online. I honestly think I’m far from the only person this has happened too I’m just one of the few not ashamed to publicly acknowledge that I downloaded and agree to pay for such drivel. Though, even I only paid for the minimum. I sure as heck didn’t agree to that plus VIP and I still fail to see what sense that makes to buy both.

reviews.title: False Advertising
reviews.text: I kept seeing ads for this app in my Pinterest feed. I was really interested in watching the drama it kept showing me. The ads said it was free to watch that specific drama. So I tried watching it. It took me to a website to watch and I got 24 “episodes” in (each episode is less than 3 minutes) and then it told me I had to subscribe to keep watching. It costs double what I pay for Disney+ or Netflix!!! So I downloaded the app thinking I would be able to earn coins or something and continue watching, but the app wants me to starting paying for episodes I already watched and it won’t let me skip to where I am in the story!

reviews.title: Good content expensive pricing
reviews.text: I enjoy the content very much the actors and story lines are great. Unfortunately I just find the app to be very expensive. When you do the check in everyday and watch 7 adds you only unlock 1 episode all of the episodes are 99 coins which seems a bit much compared to other apps! On other apps I am usually able to unlock at least 5 episodes a day which is enough to keep me interested but due to only getting one episode per day I am losing interest and honestly don’t really even know what is going on in the series I’m trying to watch! I just hope they change something where you can watch more than one episode per day with coins. Or a subscription that will get you through the whole short that doesn’t cost a fortune!

reviews.title: Extra chargers
reviews.text:
It said I could pay $8 and some change for a 2 week subscription.
I agreed and it took me to an a 3rd party site to check out. I used Apple Pay to complete the purchase. They charged me the $8 and then like 3 min later I got charged $15 back to back by them. I did not agree to that and never would have agreed to that and did not agree to any other charges or purchased additional
Coins! Growing up I watched Spanish novellas and got caught up on one of their advertisements for their mini soap and they give you enough to make it decent in the beginning and then rush the middle and the end. One mini show was enough to determine it was not worth it.

reviews.title: Packages
reviews.text: Worst platform to watch short movies by far. Asks you to leave a good review of your experience with the promise of receiving free series to watch but then goes back on their word once you have. And credits you with coins that aren’t enough to watch the series you were watching. Leaving you with half of the series unwatched. Either they just don’t care or it’s a clever way to try and squeeze more money out of existing  customers by making you buy more coins to watch the remainder of the series. I cannot explain how annoyed I am by all of this. Not a way to run a company at all. Oh and when you buy a coins package they take the payment twice claiming it was an error and it will take 7 days to refund, I believed it was an error at first but I now no longer believe this, stay away from this scamming company at all costs!!!

reviews.title: BIGGEST SCAM DO NOT GET THIS APP
reviews.text: If I could give this app zero stars, I would. I made an account with my email and paid for an $8 weekly subscription but was immediately billed the $8 and AND an additional $14 out of nowhere. I then didn’t even receive the benefits of the subscription I had supposedly just paid for and now I have spent the last several days talking with the customer support and they have done nothing to help resolve my issue. It’s always AI chat bots who claim the issue is resolved and close the case immediately so i have to start all over again with my claim and I still have not been effectively helped. I am on a weekly reoccurring subscription (allegedly) that they have my payment information for but won’t allow me access to cancel it. I strongly suggest no one get this app!!!!

reviews.title: Be careful
reviews.text: There’s hidden charges you confirm to pay when you accept the terms and conditions. The weekly subscription is cheaper than most but the hidden charges increase it. I would not mind if it was stated clearly or if customer support was helpful with it. Instead they say the charge was clear before you accept it, however, no price is listed and just by tapping at the pop up you get charged on your original method of payment.

reviews.title: Pricey Subscription
reviews.text:
It said that I still have four days left on my canceled subscription and it before the coins are needed to unlock new episodes, but that is not the case. It ask me coins for the next episode and a $20 per week is a bit pricey for me, given I had tried two weeks of it. I have earned 900+ of coins during my subscription time but when I cancelled it, the coins disappeared along with my four days of unlimited watch. What a ripoff and a scam. 😐 I would never recommend this app to anybody even to the rich, then it’ll be a waste of their money.

I cancelled it because all these dramas are short and no sequel to them when the ending is begging for a part 2, 3…etc. anyway, a one star for the effort of an app…

reviews.title: Unfortunately the prices ruin it for me.
reviews.text:
$20 a week is just too much. No disrespect but the quality of these films is not that great to be charging the same price if not more than streaming services WEEKLY. I can partially understand because typically users who are coming to the app are mainly coming for one story so you want to get your moneys worth but can there not be a way to buy individual stories themselves? or at least make coin packs less expensive so people who want to just watch one can do that and if they find the rest of the content worth it then pay the subscription? 

To put the price for buying coins into perspective, there is one drama that is like 80 episodes, price per episode is 99 coins which were just going to round to a hundred. In order to complete that series from buying coins you would around 8k coins which would translate to pay around $80 to complete ONE short. Yes they give you free coins but the coins given don’t even cover the amount for an episode 😭 so you’d have to wait a while just to save up for one episode. Keep in mind episodes range from 1-2 minutes. Imagine spending two days waiting to get enough coins to watch the next episode only for it to be a minute long. There just needs to be a way for free users to be able to watch reasonably. Not everything needs to be free that i understand, you still want to make a profit but this is excessive.

They just talk in circles and play dumb. This is 100% a scam made to take money and gain access to your account!

reviews.title: Bate and switch
reviews.text:
Even more angry- just discovered, like other people, I was charged twice! I clicked in for a 2.94 promo. Saw it was going to charge me $7 and thought that was sketch but fine. Just for a receipt saying “thanks for making a purchase” which I never did, and it was $16! I am now out $25 and literally haven’t watched a single episode that I haven’t already seen for free in their ads! How is Apple allowing this to stay in here??? Oh and even better- impossible to find where to cancel! Originally review below. 


  Was inundated with ads for one show so I finally caved and paid for the trial. Once in, come to find out you’re going to have to pay substantially more to watch a :30-50 second chapter with mediocre acting and production value? I was literally able to see more chapters in an ad than I can see now that I actually have a subscription. I also refuse to believe all of these positive reviews. There’s no way so many people are okay with this bate and switch model.

reviews.title: My coins disappeared
reviews.text: I had accumulated 500+ coins from watching adverts and doing the daily tasks. However, when I watched my first episode that required coins I was prompted to pay as the app said only had 7 coins. I tried again and checked again today but it still says only have 7 coins. There’s no coin history option so I can’t  see where my coins went. These coins were free so I’m just annoyed but if I had paid for these coins I would be outraged. I would avoid this app because of this. There’s also no way to just pay a subscription and have access to all the shows, they only have a subscription for coins so there’s no way to avoid using coins which could disappear at any point

reviews.title: Sneaky subscription - beware
reviews.text:
The content is good - keeps you hooked but the subscription process is sneaky and frustrating. I cancelled the subscription multiple times and it advised that this had been cancelled but the subscription was not cancelled and could only be cancelled on the next billing date which makes it easy to forget and get unnecessarily charged again. 

On top of this - I was unexpectedly upgraded to a higher more expensive tier of subscription without my consent and really had to fight to get my money back - they told me I had used the additional content, even though I had contacted them within 10 minutes of being upgraded! 

I’d advise others to proceed  carefully and keep a very close eye on your billing! 

Sneaky subscription tactics!

reviews.title: The worst manipulative app with reels

They only show one you agree on and then charge extra two without you approving them apparently hidden while you setting up . Pay pal despite is also open . Please take a shower and try not to buy from them make sure you lock all your money from them and cancel subscription straight away . reviews.title: Questionable business tactics
reviews.text:
While the content they show on social channels looks enticing, I had the subscription services for one month and found that not enough content rolled out nor did some of the content they showed that grabbed my attention actually make the Final Cut.

I requested then a refund for this subscription, subsequently also wanting to cancel my plan. They followed up clarifying that they would love to hear feedback on what else I’d like to see in addition to not having all the shots in trailer end up in the Final movie is customary ending. The ended the email asking if I needed anything else.

Realizing they were still charging me I followed up again, only to find that I needed to respond to that follow up email sating I still wanted a refund. Personally, I have not been involved in a subscription service where you first email request for refund and cancelation is not adequate. I’d be cautious moving forward.

reviews.title: Expensive - Do Not Purchase
reviews.text: So much more expensive than other Short Drama Apps. Even when you pay the Gold fee for £20, you only get to watch half a film before they ask you to buy more coins. One film can end up costing you £40!? Other Apps charge you a flat out fee and you can watch unlimited content for that period. My Drama is so shortsighted. If you got rid of the coin purchasing, people would trust you more, re-subscribe/renew and customers wouldn’t be left feeling scammed. Really poor and it gives the whole genre a bad name, making people believe it is just a money making scam.

reviews.title: Cool but expensive
reviews.text:
The content is cool, not going to lie, pretty entertaining and the actual app is good, UX is definitely decent but everything is behind a paywall. You can watch approximately 7 (1min) “episodes” before having to pay or watch different 2 to 4min ads for coins. Oh and the amount of coins per episode gets more and more expensive as you watch and unlock them. It goes from 70 coins to 99 or more. You end up having to watch two minutes of ads to unlock 45 seconds of content, and you only have 7 chances to watch ads. The lowest purchase you can make is 200 coins for $2, basically making it $1 per minute. If you want to unlock it all, the lowest subscription is $20 per week! It’s super expensive and ultimately not worth it at all.

TLDR: don’t download it unless you want to spend way too much money or waste too much time watching ads for very little content.

reviews.title: It’s extremely frustrating and annoying for viewers.
reviews.text: Although the storyline is interesting, it requires far too many coins just to unlock and watch episodes—even after already paying for a subscription. I expected to be able to watch freely like on other apps, but instead each episode still needs to be unlocked and paid for. It’s extremely frustrating and annoying for viewers.

reviews.title: Very misleading advertisement
reviews.text:
BUYER BEWARE!!You see an advertisement of somebody saying “I found this the best app to watch short stories and it’s free”
So you figure why not? I’ll try the app so you download it you fill out your information you start watching the series and then all of a sudden it’s gone you can’t finish the rest of it and I think it’s ridiculous that you have to pay 99 stars to watch one more episode the price is ridiculous to buy the stars and I just think it’s very misleading. There’s too many other apps out there that will let you watch the stories by earning the stars by watching ads we’re coming back the next 24 hours and you’re able to watch another chunk 30 minutes of that particular story for free This app does not give you that option.  Again, I say buyer beware

reviews.title: Expensive
reviews.text: I see these short stories and the app advertised all the time on FB but it’s way too expensive to even bother trying to watch any further. Whilst I understand it’s to help pay the creators & filming expenses etc the prices are ridiculous and unreasonable, which is unfortunate as the stories can be alright to watch. 🤷🏻‍♀️

reviews.title: Keeps going back locking episodes I watched.
reviews.text:
There’s something wrong with this app I was already at episode 19 with one of the stories And out of nowhere  It started again at episode 11 and locked the rest. And now it keeps playing episode 16and it won’t unlock further. I do not recommend this app they only let you watch two episodes of 40 seconds per day.
I much prefer Pocket FM they give you almost 10 minute episode episodes and they let you watch a bunch per day. You gotta watch like 30 minutes of commercial ads to be able to watch    1 2 minute episode and 1 20 second episode. Not worth my time at all. And I’m not paying $20 per week to watch.

reviews.title: False advertising
reviews.text: Appears all over instagram advertising series to watch for free for limited time but when opening and downloading the app you can watch first few episodes then have to pay quite expensive amounts for coins or a subscription to watch past episode 10 - disappointing

reviews.title: Expensive
reviews.text: Let’s you watch a few episodes and then you can’t watch any more without paying a lot of money so it’s a pointless app. It would be better if you could watch some each day or pay for unlimited but they’re cheesy fan fiction style dramas and cost more than all my tv subscriptions combined!

reviews.title: Misleading
reviews.text:
I saw an add on insta mentioning free episodes on a certain story but then asked for you to purchase a subscription …. Other sites provide free initial episodes to allow you to become interested in the story so nothing special there. 
I opted for both Refill at £5.99 then an additional £9.99 for premium and that didn’t even give me access to watch episodes for free!!! Wildly expensive for low budget movies. Despite story’s being interesting this is crazy expensive!!  Wouldn’t bother if I was you.

reviews.title: Subscription
reviews.text: They don’t have an option for a subscription that will unlock or episodes. For example, all other apps have an option where you can subscribe weekly monthly or yearly to unlock all episodes on the app, but in this app, you have to keep paying for coins over and over again .. even the subscription offer is for coins so you can get daily coins so if you want to finish a show in the same day, you’re just gonna have to keep buying coins to unlock episodes. None of the offers they have in the store will have enough coins to unlock a full show or drama you’re just gonna have to keep paying so you can finish the show that you’re watching which will end up being like $100 for one show

reviews.title: Amazing Acting! However…
reviews.text: The group of actors this company uses is genuinely amazing! They are all so talented and when compared to actors on other platforms My Drama actors blow them out of the water. Same to say with the camera crew and the production as a whole. However… even after paying LOADS of money for an exclusive membership you still can’t watch more than MAYBE one to two episodes a day unless you want to pay an outrageous amount of money for more coins. Why is there no subscription plan like all the other platforms that allow you to pay weekly or monthly and have access to every episode!? It makes me so sad because I’m about ready to cancel every transaction I make with this company and delete the app so I can just forget about wanting to watch more shows. It’s not right to barter such an insane amount of money for genuinely no benefit.
